sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The maamar explains that there were two miracles within the miracle of the oil, and questions why no additional commemoration was established for the 26th of Kislev.

translations.translation: And the maamar continues,
that in the miracle of the oil itself there were two miracles.
The miracle
that they found one cruse of pure oil sealed with the seal of the Kohen Gadol,
this miracle
(of finding the cruse of oil)
occurred on the 25th of Kislev,
and the miracle that there was only enough to light for one day yet they lit from it for eight days,
for this miracle began on the 26th of Kislev.
And the maamar asks precisely,
why was no additional commemoration established on the 26th of Kislev, when the miracle of the oil lasting eight days began?

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The explanation is that the miracle of military victory is Yichuda Tata'ah, the miracle of finding pure oil is Yichuda Ila'ah, and the miracle of the oil lasting eight days, beginning on the 26th, is from a level above even Yichuda Ila'ah.

translations.translation: And the point of the explanation in the maamar is,
that the miracle of the military victory is Yichuda Tata'ah,
and the miracle of finding the cruse of pure oil is Yichuda Ila'ah.
And this is that the miracle of military victory was on the 24th of Kislev and the miracle of finding the cruse of oil was on the 25th of Kislev,
for the number 24 alludes to Yichuda Tata'ah corresponding to the 24 letters
of "Baruch shem kevod malchuso le'olam va'ed",
and the number 25 alludes to Yichuda Ila'ah corresponding to the 25 letters
of the verse
"Shema Yisrael... Hashem Echad."
And the miracle of the oil lasting eight days, which began on the 26th of Kislev,
26 being the gematria of the Name Havayah,
is a level above even Yichuda Ila'ah.
For although even Yichuda Ila'ah is in the Name Havayah
(Hashem Echad),
as explained in many places
that the nullification stemming from the Name Elokim is nullification of the yesh (existence)
(Yichuda Tata'ah),
and the nullification of Yichuda Ila'ah
(nullification of existence)
is specifically from the Name Havayah,
nevertheless,
that which is written regarding it "Hashem Echad"
(and not Yachid),
meaning that there are seven heavens and earth and four directions of the world, but they are nullified and unified with Ein Sof, the Master of the world,
is because this Havayah is the Havayah of Hishtalshelus (the chain of descent),
the lower Havayah.
For this is what is written,
"Hashem Elokeinu, Hashem Echad",
where the first Havayah is the upper Havayah
which is above Hishtalshelus,
and regarding this Havayah it cannot be said that He is "one" with seven heavens and earth and four directions of the world,
for He is Yachid (singular) and nothing else exists,
and the second Havayah is the lower Havayah,
the Havayah of Hishtalshelus,
and therefore the term "Echad" applies to it.
And this is the superiority of the miracle of the oil lasting eight days, which began on the 26th of Kislev
(26 being the gematria of Havayah)
over the miracle of finding the cruse of pure oil,
for the miracle of finding the cruse of oil, which was on the 25th
(of Kislev)
corresponding to the 25 letters of "Shema Yisrael"
(Yichuda Ila'ah),
its drawing down is from the lower Havayah,
"Hashem Echad",
and the miracle of the cruse of oil lasting eight days,
where the number eight indicates a level above Hishtalshelus,
its drawing down is from the upper Havayah, which is above Hishtalshelus.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: It can be said that even the 25 letters of Shema Yisrael represent a level of "Koh" relative to the upper Havayah, and the true essence of this level is in the miracle of the oil lasting eight days.

translations.translation: And it can be said,
that this is also that in "Shema Yisrael" there are 25 letters,
the aspect of "Koh",
even though Yichuda Ila'ah
(in general)
is the aspect of "Zeh",
for the lower Havayah relative to the upper Havayah is considered like Elokim
(contraction),
and the nullification of Yichuda Ila'ah stemming from the lower Havayah
(relative to the upper Havayah)
is like Yichuda Tata'ah,
"Koh".
And likewise is the miracle of finding the cruse of oil, which was on the 25th of Kislev,
which is the aspect of "Koh"
relative to the upper Havayah,
and the true essence of this aspect is in the miracle of the oil lasting eight days, which began on the 26th of Kislev,
whose drawing down is from the upper Havayah, which is above Hishtalshelus.
